title: Replication of Agentic Security Events: Audit and Investigation (ROGUE-AI)
abstract: arXiv:2611.26553v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agents based on large language models (LLMs) can now delete files and send payments on behalf of their users. News media reports routinely describe failures of these agents (e.g., Replit's coding agent deleting a production database), but a report often only says what went wrong and rarely (in)validates the incident or finds its root cause. Incident catalogs collect these reports, and benchmarks record whether agents fail, but neither replicates an incident nor tests the cause its report might identify. In this paper, we present ROGUE-AI (Replication of Agentic Security Events: Audit and Investigation), a multi-agent framework that closes the above gap and rebuilds each reported incident offline together with a matched control that lacks only the blamed cause, and runs agents on both. Our results suggest that ROGUE-AI is able to reproduce the reported harm in 89% of its 108 attempted replications. Agents built on five current GPT, Clau

translated_title: 代理式安全事件复现：审计与调查（ROGUE-AI）
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体现在可以代表用户删除文件和发送付款。新闻媒体报道经常描述这些智能体的失败案例（例如，Replit的编程智能体删除了生产数据库），但报道通常只说明出了什么问题，很少对事件进行（不）验证或找出其根本原因。事件目录收集了这些报告，基准测试记录了智能体是否失败，但两者都没有复现事件，也没有检验其报道中可能指出的原因。在本文中，我们提出了ROGUE-AI（代理式安全事件复现：审计与调查），这是一个多智能体框架，弥补了上述空白：它在离线环境中重建每个被报道的事件，并同时构建一个仅缺少所归咎原因的匹配对照组，然后在两者上运行智能体。我们的结果表明，ROGUE-AI在108次复现尝试中能够以89%的成功率重现所报道的危害。基于五个当前GPT、Clau（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ROGUE-AI多智能体框架，通过离线复现被报道的LLM智能体安全事件并构建仅缺少所归咎原因的匹配对照组进行对照实验，在108次复现尝试中89%成功重现所报道的危害，从而验证事件真实性并定位根本原因。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces ROGUE-AI, a multi-agent framework that replicates reported LLM agent security incidents offline alongside matched controls lacking the blamed cause, successfully reproducing the reported harm in 89% of 108 attempts to validate incidents and identify root causes.
